name: Deva Fallen Star

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

items.name: Rod Implement
items.description: Using a nonmagical implement confers no benefit. You can purchase a magic implement to gain an enhancement bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls with your arcane powers.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

hit.description: psychic and radiant damage, and the deva fallen star makes a secondary attack against the target
nestedAttackDescriptions: the fallen star gains total concealment against the target (save ends)

powers.name: Fateful Transposition
powers.trigger: when an enemy attacks the deva fallen star

hit.description: the target swaps positions with the deva fallen star. The triggering enemy’s attack deals half damage to the fallen star, and the target takes damage equal to half the attack’s damage
psychic damage, and the target can use only basic attacks and at-will powers during its next turn
radiant damage, and the target takes ongoing 15 necrotic damage (save ends)

effect.description: The deva fallen star adds 1d8 to or subtracts 1d8 from an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw made by itself or any creature within 10 squares of it.

powers.name: Vile Rebirth
powers.trigger: when the deva fallen star is reduced to 0 hit points

effect.description: The fallen star does not die and instead remains at 0 hit points until the start of its next turn, when it regains 25 hit points, loses resistance to radiant damage, and gains the undead keyword. This power recharges, and the triggering damage type changes to nonradiant damage.
